title: Who’s Asking? Simulating Role-Based Questions for Conversational AI Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating role-based question variants (patient, caregiver, and practitioner) for the same underlying query using the CORUS framework, and comparing LLM responses across metrics of knowledge content, emotional support, readability, and abstention/refusal rates to identify systematic shifts based on the asker's implicit social role.
